curve_evidence_scope: Hash-reviewed same-object source dataflow plus saved curve/event/actual tracking. There is no independent per-step command log.

runner_static_contract.scope: Only two explicitly reviewed runner hashes and two explicitly reviewed helper hashes are accepted. The second runner reverses only exact final report serialization lines; the new helper reverses only the height policy lower bound .15 to .25, both byte-for-byte to the originals. Four original guard/yaw/execute methods remain exact baseline AST. This is source dataflow evidence, not an observed per-step command log.

independent_source_physical_review.scope: Original actual-state geometry checks. Paired-mean fingers are the original planning approximation; raw native reactions remain separately mandatory.

soft_sweep_scope: Source/pose/displacement/count/clear-status/6mm certificate metadata are checked. This audit does not rerun the convex separation search.

every_step_reaction_audit.scope: IPC soft-coupling STC feedback; excludes native Genesis rigid-contact force
limitations: Positive finger-axis projections plus material proximity are grip evidence, not force-closure proof.
Saved per-link origins and aim axes are independently checked by the richer contact trace audit.
Raw engineering force and moment limits are uncalibrated; baseline subtraction never waives them.

independent_endpoint_physical_review.scope: Original actual-state geometry checks. Paired-mean fingers are the original planning approximation; raw native reactions remain separately mandatory.

actual.scope: 21 original paired-finger opening states; no continuous opening certificate.

commanded.scope: 21 original paired-finger opening states; no continuous opening certificate.

mass.bag_mass_formula: rest area * density * 2 * IPC thickness radius

bag_topology.body_face_selection: explicit physical body-face labels mapped to imported rest mesh

original_final_validator.inverted_volume_fraction_sampling_scope: Full saved frames only; per-step minimum J cannot recover inverted volume.

soft_metric_sampling.sampling_scope: Soft summary at each recorded integration step; full geometry at saved frames.

motion_thresholds.source: config.validation or conservative audit defaults; not robot manufacturer limits

final_contact.method: Discrete bag vertex, edge-midpoint and triangle-centroid winding/distance samples

left_handle_hold_evidence.distance_definition: Nearest vertex belonging to the exact configured left grasp material group
left_handle_hold_evidence.sampling_scope: Every saved full-geometry frame after right-handle release starts
left_handle_hold_evidence.force_evidence_scope: Saved get_dofs_control_force PD values; not native contact force

limitations: Saved geometry and integration-step summaries do not certify continuous nonpenetration between recorded states.
Two-way IPC ABD versus rendered link transform error is unavailable in these arrays.
Finger opening and event timestamps support sequence checks but do not certify force closure.
Named strap proximity and negative finger PD are independent hold evidence, not measured native contact forces; the IPC soft-contact guard provides complementary reaction evidence.
Material values remain uncalibrated; no real-world success claim follows.
This is an audit of saved native states and the archived reference, not task success.
Robot clearance/FK reference checks are sampled; force and grip evidence remains the every-step native guard.
Frozen bear/left arc certificates concern ideal rigid grasp and two static left poses only.
A saved spline is execution evidence, not an independently observed command stream. Actual joints are checked separately.

frozen_angle_policy.extraction: Static AST recognition; frozen helper is not imported or executed

corrections.distance_scope: Sum of observed correction endpoint XY displacements, not oscillatory path arc length
corrections.limits: CPU saved-state sequencing/budget audit; physical guards and final containment must independently pass.

rim.scope: Frozen policy identity and report arithmetic only; no independent cloth-feasibility, body fit, collision, or physical-success certificate.

recenter.scope: Config/record policy only. No successful motion, physical guard, or task completion follows from this check.

limitations: External robot mesh hashes are measured at this review, not established as startup hashes.
The input manifest covers scene source/config/copied assets, not installed Genesis/libuipc binaries or all environment dependencies.
Hash consistency proves recorded inputs match the manifest; it does not prove physical correctness or task success.
Reactions are IPC soft-coupling feedback, not contact forces identified by individual material.
Material proximity and four positive opening-axis reactions support held-handle evidence; they do not prove force closure.
Checks cover recorded integration states only.
Exact algebraic reconstruction checks stored reaction geometry, not independent native solver pair forces.
Left link7 contains the welded palm. Its nonzero reaction alone cannot identify teddy versus cloth contact.
No new force or torque limits are imposed by these diagnostic summaries.

original_richer_contact_audit.note: Only independent-task containment, physics, sequencing and force-limit audits can establish simulated task success.

limits: The original cap validity test is not a general body embedding/self-intersection certificate; all-node count is not whole-tetrahedron or volume containment.
The 50% interim criterion never replaces original final all-node, COM, released-finger and retention checks.
401 reference/FK checks are sampled; continuous reference rates concern commands, not every native dynamic velocity.
Failed or incomplete execution never becomes successful because a planning candidate exists.
